heading: Threat model
body: `bare-buffer` is one of the addons Bare compiles into its binary, so it inherits [Bare's threat model](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md). The module's own [threat model](https://github.com/holepunchto/bare-buffer/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md), added in v3.7.2, says where it sits in that one.
